title: Design Studio Selections Goodwill: Points for Calloway Home Mortgage Financing
content:
**Q. Does the financing of the home change the goodwill percent on a Design Studio Selections file?**
Yes. Points are added to the goodwill percent according to the financing of the Home Purchase Agreement the file serves:

- where the agreement is financed through Calloway Home Mortgage and the Builder Extended Rate Lock on that agreement is locked, 5 points are added;
- where the agreement is financed through Calloway Home Mortgage and no rate lock on that agreement is locked, 2.5 points are added;
- where the agreement is financed by an outside lender or by cash, no points are added.

**Q. Which records decide?**
The financing type shown on the Home Purchase Agreement, and the status of the Builder Extended Rate Lock held on that same agreement.

**Q. When are the points added?**
The points are added to the goodwill percent before that percent is applied to the error amount.

**Q. What if the agreement is financed through Calloway Home Mortgage and its rate lock stands in any status other than locked, or no lock exists?**
No rate lock on the agreement is locked, so 2.5 points are added.

| Financing on the Home Purchase Agreement | Builder Extended Rate Lock on the agreement | Points |
|---|---|---|
| Calloway Home Mortgage | Locked | 5 |
| Calloway Home Mortgage | None locked | 2.5 |
| Outside lender | Any | 0 |
| Cash | — | 0 |

*Hypothetical figure:* a goodwill percent of 10 on an agreement financed through Calloway Home Mortgage with a locked rate lock becomes 15 percent; an error amount of 2000.00 at 15 percent gives 300.00.
